60	    """Infer formulation, model, seed, complexity from directory name."""
61	    name = os.path.basename(dirpath).lower()
62	
63	    if "cwm" in name:
64	        formulation = "CWM"
65	    elif "traj" in name:
66	        formulation = "TRAJ"
67	    elif "cls" in name:

72	    if "qwen" in name:
73	        model = "Qwen3-8B"
74	    elif "deepseek" in name:
75	        model = "DeepSeek-6.7B"
76	    else:
77	        model = "UNKNOWN"
78	
79	    m = re.search(r"s(\d+)", name)
80	    seed = int(m.group(1)) if m else 42
81	
82	    complexity = "function" if "func" in name else "repo"
83	
84	    return dict(formulation=formulation, model=model, seed=seed,
85	                complexity=complexity)

182	def fit_mixed_lm(df: pd.DataFrame, formula: str,
183	                 groups_col: str = "problem_id",
184	                 label: str = "") -> tuple[dict, object]:
185	    """Fit MixedLM (Linear Probability Model). Coefficients are probability diffs (pp), not log-odds."""
186	    import statsmodels.formula.api as smf
187	
188	    df = df.copy()
189	    for col in ["formulation", "model", "complexity", "mutation_type"]:
190	        if col in df.columns:
191	            df[col] = df[col].astype(str)
192	
193	    print(f"\n{'=' * 60}", file=sys.stderr)
194	    print(f"{label}", file=sys.stderr)
195	    print(f"  {formula} + (1|{groups_col})", file=sys.stderr)
196	    print(f"  N={len(df)}, groups={df[groups_col].nunique()}", file=sys.stderr)
197	
198	    md = smf.mixedlm(formula, df, groups=df[groups_col])
199	    try:
200	        result = md.fit(reml=True)
201	    except np.linalg.LinAlgError:
202	        # Singular design matrix — drop interaction and retry with main effects only
203	        fallback = re.sub(r"\s*\*\s*", " + ", formula)
204	        print(f"  WARN: singular matrix with interaction, fallback → {fallback}",
205	              file=sys.stderr)
206	        md = smf.mixedlm(fallback, df, groups=df[groups_col])
207	        result = md.fit(reml=True)
208	        formula = fallback
209	    print(result.summary(), file=sys.stderr)
210	
211	    # --- fixed effects ---
212	    fe = result.fe_params
213	    se = result.bse_fe
214	    ci = result.conf_int()
215	    pvals = result.pvalues
216	
217	    coefficients = {}
218	    for name in fe.index:
219	        coefficients[name] = dict(
220	            coef=round(float(fe[name]), 4),
221	            se=round(float(se[name]), 4),
222	            z=round(float(fe[name] / se[name]) if se[name] > 0 else 0, 3),
223	            p=round(float(pvals[name]), 4) if name in pvals.index else None,
224	            ci_lower=round(float(ci.loc[name, 0]), 4),
225	            ci_upper=round(float(ci.loc[name, 1]), 4),
226	        )
227	
228	    # --- random effects ---
229	    re_var = (float(result.cov_re.iloc[0, 0])
230	              if hasattr(result.cov_re, "iloc")
231	              else float(result.cov_re))
232	
233	    # --- joint Wald tests (ANOVA-like) ---
234	    anova = _joint_wald_tests(result)
235	
236	    out = dict(
237	        formula=formula,
238	        n_obs=len(df),
239	        n_groups=int(df[groups_col].nunique()),
240	        coefficients=coefficients,
241	        random_effects=dict(
242	            group=groups_col,
243	            variance=round(re_var, 6),
244	            sd=round(float(np.sqrt(max(re_var, 0))), 4),
245	        ),
246	        anova=anova,
247	        log_likelihood=round(float(result.llf), 2),
248	    )
249	    return out, result

252	def _joint_wald_tests(result) -> dict:
253	    """Compute joint Wald χ² for each model term (main effects + interaction)."""
254	    from scipy import stats as sp_stats
255	
256	    param_names = list(result.fe_params.index)
257	    terms: dict[str, list[int]] = {}
258	
259	    for i, name in enumerate(param_names):
260	        if name == "Intercept":
261	            continue
262	        if ":" in name:
263	            term = "interaction"
264	        elif "formulation" in name:
265	            term = "formulation"
266	        elif "model" in name:
267	            term = "model"
268	        elif "complexity" in name or "mutation_type" in name:
269	            term = "complexity"
270	        else:
271	            term = name
272	        terms.setdefault(term, []).append(i)
273	
274	    anova = {}
275	    for term, indices in terms.items():
276	        beta = result.fe_params.values[indices]
277	        cov = result.cov_params().iloc[indices, :]
278	        cov = cov.iloc[:, indices].values
279	        try:
280	            chi2 = float(beta @ np.linalg.solve(cov, beta))
281	            df = len(indices)
282	            p = float(1 - sp_stats.chi2.cdf(chi2, df))
283	            anova[term] = dict(wald_chi2=round(chi2, 3), df=df,
284	                               p=round(p, 4))
285	        except np.linalg.LinAlgError:
286	            anova[term] = dict(wald_chi2=None, df=len(indices), p=None,
287	                               error="singular covariance")
288	    return anova

292	# Empirical odds ratios with bootstrap CI
293	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
294	
295	def empirical_odds_ratios(df: pd.DataFrame, group_col: str,
296	                          ref_level: str, n_boot: int = 2000) -> dict:
297	    """Odds ratio of each group level vs. ref_level, with bootstrap 95% CI."""
298	    rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
299	    ref = df.loc[df[group_col] == ref_level, "correct"].values
300	
301	    results = {}
302	    for level in sorted(df[group_col].unique()):
303	        vals = df.loc[df[group_col] == level, "correct"].values
304	        p = vals.mean()
305	        p_ref = ref.mean()
306	        odds = p / (1 - p) if 0 < p < 1 else float("inf")
307	        odds_ref = p_ref / (1 - p_ref) if 0 < p_ref < 1 else float("inf")
308	        or_val = (odds / odds_ref
309	                  if odds_ref not in (0, float("inf")) else None)
310	
311	        boot_ors = []
312	        for _ in range(n_boot):
313	            br = rng.choice(ref, size=len(ref), replace=True)
314	            bs = rng.choice(vals, size=len(vals), replace=True)
315	            pr, ps = br.mean(), bs.mean()
316	            if 0 < pr < 1 and 0 < ps < 1:
317	                boot_ors.append((ps / (1 - ps)) / (pr / (1 - pr)))
318	
319	        if boot_ors:
320	            ci_lo, ci_hi = np.percentile(boot_ors, [2.5, 97.5])
321	        else:
322	            ci_lo = ci_hi = None
323	
324	        results[level] = dict(
325	            accuracy=round(float(p), 4),
326	            n=int(len(vals)),
327	            or_vs_ref=(round(float(or_val), 4)
328	                       if or_val is not None else None),
329	            or_ci_lower=(round(float(ci_lo), 4)
330	                         if ci_lo is not None else None),
331	            or_ci_upper=(round(float(ci_hi), 4)
332	                         if ci_hi is not None else None),
333	        )
334	    return results

341	def _clean_param_name(name: str) -> str:
342	    """Shorten statsmodels-style parameter names for LaTeX."""
343	    name = name.replace("C(formulation)", "Form.")
344	    name = name.replace("C(model)", "Model")
345	    name = name.replace("C(complexity)", "Compl.")
346	    name = name.replace("C(mutation_type)", "Mut.")
347	    name = name.replace("[T.", "[")
348	    return name.replace("_", r"\_")

351	def _fmt_p(p: float | None) -> str:
352	    if p is None:
353	        return "---"
354	    if p < 0.001:
355	        return "$<$.001"
356	    s = f"{p:.3f}"
357	    if p < 0.01:
358	        return s + "**"
359	    if p < 0.05:
360	        return s + "*"
361	    return s

364	def format_latex_table(results: dict, caption: str, label: str) -> str:
365	    coeffs = results["coefficients"]
366	    re = results["random_effects"]
367	
368	    lines = [
369	        r"\begin{table}[t]",
370	        r"\centering\small",
371	        rf"\caption{{{caption}}}",
372	        rf"\label{{{label}}}",
373	        r"\begin{tabular}{lrrrr}",
374	        r"\toprule",
375	        r"Effect & Coef.\ (pp) & SE & $z$ & $p$ \\",
376	        r"\midrule",
377	    ]
378	    for name, v in coeffs.items():
379	        dn = _clean_param_name(name)
380	        lines.append(
381	            f"{dn} & {v['coef']:+.3f} & {v['se']:.3f} "
382	            f"& {v['z']:.2f} & {_fmt_p(v['p'])} \\\\"
383	        )
384	    lines.append(r"\midrule")
385	    lines.append(
386	        rf"$\sigma^2_{{\text{{pid}}}}$ & "
387	        rf"\multicolumn{{4}}{{c}}{{{re['variance']:.4f} "
388	        rf"(SD={re['sd']:.3f})}} \\"
389	    )
390	    lines += [r"\bottomrule", r"\end{tabular}", r"\end{table}"]
391	    return "\n".join(lines)
392

394	def format_or_latex(or_dict: dict, ref: str, caption: str,
395	                    label: str) -> str:
396	    """LaTeX table for empirical odds ratios."""
397	    lines = [
398	        r"\begin{table}[t]",
399	        r"\centering\small",
400	        rf"\caption{{{caption}}}",
401	        rf"\label{{{label}}}",
402	        r"\begin{tabular}{lrrrl}",
403	        r"\toprule",
404	        rf"Formulation & Acc. & OR (vs.\ {ref}) & 95\% CI & $n$ \\",
405	        r"\midrule",
406	    ]
407	    for level, v in or_dict.items():
408	        or_str = (f"{v['or_vs_ref']:.2f}"
409	                  if v["or_vs_ref"] is not None else "ref")
410	        ci_str = (f"[{v['or_ci_lower']:.2f}, {v['or_ci_upper']:.2f}]"
411	                  if v["or_ci_lower"] is not None else "---")
412	        if level == ref:
413	            or_str, ci_str = "1.00", "ref"
414	        lines.append(
415	            f"{level} & {v['accuracy']:.3f} & {or_str} & {ci_str} "
416	            f"& {v['n']} \\\\"
417	        )
418	    lines += [r"\bottomrule", r"\end{tabular}", r"\end{table}"]
419	    return "\n".join(lines)

"""
W5 Mixed-Effects Linear Probability Model (LPM) (v2): multi-seed CWM support.

Uses statsmodels MixedLM (not logistic regression). Coefficients represent
probability differences in percentage points (pp), not log-odds ratios.

Cross-complexity model: correct ~ formulation * complexity + (1|problem_id)
Cross-model model:     correct ~ formulation * model + (1|problem_id)

Input:
  --eval_dirs   comma-separated eval result directories
  --data_dir    directory with {test,cwm_test}.jsonl for mutation_type metadata
  --output_dir  output directory for JSON + LaTeX

Output:
  w5_mixed_effects_results.json   combined model results
  w5_latex_tables.tex             LaTeX table fragments

Dependencies: pandas, numpy, statsmodels (>=0.14), scipy
"""

import argparse
import json
import os
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# CLI
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def parse_args():
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="W5 Mixed-Effects LPM: formulation × complexity / model (coefficients = probability diff in pp)"
    )
    p.add_argument("--eval_dirs", required=True,
                   help="Comma-separated eval result directories")
    p.add_argument("--data_dir", default=None,
                   help="Directory with test.jsonl / cwm_test.jsonl for "
                        "mutation_type metadata (optional)")
    p.add_argument("--output_dir", default="artifacts/w5_mixed_effects",
                   help="Output directory (default: artifacts/w5_mixed_effects)")
    p.add_argument("--ref_formulation", default="CLS",
                   help="Reference formulation for empirical odds ratios (default: CLS)")
    p.add_argument("--bootstrap_n", type=int, default=2000,
                   help="Bootstrap iterations for OR CIs (default: 2000)")
    return p.parse_args()


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Path → metadata inference
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def infer_metadata(dirpath: str) -> dict:
    """Infer formulation, model, seed, complexity from directory name."""
    name = os.path.basename(dirpath).lower()

    if "cwm" in name:
        formulation = "CWM"
    elif "traj" in name:
        formulation = "TRAJ"
    elif "cls" in name:
        formulation = "CLS"
    else:
        formulation = "UNKNOWN"

    if "qwen" in name:
        model = "Qwen3-8B"
    elif "deepseek" in name:
        model = "DeepSeek-6.7B"
    else:

def find_prediction_file(dirpath: str) -> str | None:
    """Locate the prediction JSONL inside an eval directory."""
    p = Path(dirpath)
    for pattern in ["eval_*_predictions.jsonl", "predictions_*.jsonl"]:
        hits = sorted(p.glob(pattern))
        if hits:
            return str(hits[0])
    for name in ["results_incremental.jsonl", "predictions.jsonl"]:
        fp = p / name
        if fp.exists():
            return str(fp)
    return None

def load_jsonl(path: str) -> list[dict]:
    records = []

def load_metadata(data_dir: str) -> dict:
    """Load problem metadata (mutation_type, source) from test splits."""
    meta = {}

def fit_mixed_lm(df: pd.DataFrame, formula: str,
                 groups_col: str = "problem_id",
                 label: str = "") -> tuple[dict, object]:
    """Fit MixedLM (Linear Probability Model). Coefficients are probability diffs (pp), not log-odds."""
    import statsmodels.formula.api as smf

    df = df.copy()
    for col in ["formulation", "model", "complexity", "mutation_type"]:
        if col in df.columns:
            df[col] = df[col].astype(str)

    print(f"\n{'=' * 60}", file=sys.stderr)
    print(f"{label}", file=sys.stderr)
    print(f"  {formula} + (1|{groups_col})", file=sys.stderr)
    print(f"  N={len(df)}, groups={df[groups_col].nunique()}", file=sys.stderr)

    md = smf.mixedlm(formula, df, groups=df[groups_col])
    try:
        result = md.fit(reml=True)
    except np.linalg.LinAlgError:
        # Singular design matrix — drop interaction and retry with main effects only
        fallback = re.sub(r"\s*\*\s*", " + ", formula)
        print(f"  WARN: singular matrix with interaction, fallback → {fallback}",
              file=sys.stderr)
        md = smf.mixedlm(fallback, df, groups=df[groups_col])
        result = md.fit(reml=True)
        formula = fallback
    print(result.summary(), file=sys.stderr)

    # --- fixed effects ---
    fe = result.fe_params
    se = result.bse_fe
    ci = result.conf_int()
    pvals = result.pvalues

    coefficients = {}
    for name in fe.index:
        coefficients[name] = dict(
            coef=round(float(fe[name]), 4),
            se=round(float(se[name]), 4),
            z=round(float(fe[name] / se[name]) if se[name] > 0 else 0, 3),
            p=round(float(pvals[name]), 4) if name in pvals.index else None,
            ci_lower=round(float(ci.loc[name, 0]), 4),
            ci_upper=round(float(ci.loc[name, 1]), 4),
        )

    # --- random effects ---
    re_var = (float(result.cov_re.iloc[0, 0])
              if hasattr(result.cov_re, "iloc")
              else float(result.cov_re))

    # --- joint Wald tests (ANOVA-like) ---
    anova = _joint_wald_tests(result)

    out = dict(
        formula=formula,
        n_obs=len(df),
        n_groups=int(df[groups_col].nunique()),
        coefficients=coefficients,
        random_effects=dict(
            group=groups_col,
            variance=round(re_var, 6),
            sd=round(float(np.sqrt(max(re_var, 0))), 4),
        ),
        anova=anova,
        log_likelihood=round(float(result.llf), 2),
    )
    return out, result


def _joint_wald_tests(result) -> dict:
    """Compute joint Wald χ² for each model term (main effects + interaction)."""
    from scipy import stats as sp_stats

    param_names = list(result.fe_params.index)
    terms: dict[str, list[int]] = {}

    for i, name in enumerate(param_names):
        if name == "Intercept":
            continue
        if ":" in name:
            term = "interaction"
        elif "formulation" in name:
            term = "formulation"
        elif "model" in name:
            term = "model"
        elif "complexity" in name or "mutation_type" in name:
            term = "complexity"
        else:
            term = name
        terms.setdefault(term, []).append(i)

    anova = {}
    for term, indices in terms.items():
        beta = result.fe_params.values[indices]
        cov = result.cov_params().iloc[indices, :]
        cov = cov.iloc[:, indices].values
        try:
            chi2 = float(beta @ np.linalg.solve(cov, beta))
            df = len(indices)
            p = float(1 - sp_stats.chi2.cdf(chi2, df))
            anova[term] = dict(wald_chi2=round(chi2, 3), df=df,
                               p=round(p, 4))
        except np.linalg.LinAlgError:
            anova[term] = dict(wald_chi2=None, df=len(indices), p=None,
                               error="singular covariance")
    return anova


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Empirical odds ratios with bootstrap CI
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def empirical_odds_ratios(df: pd.DataFrame, group_col: str,
                          ref_level: str, n_boot: int = 2000) -> dict:
    """Odds ratio of each group level vs. ref_level, with bootstrap 95% CI."""
    rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
    ref = df.loc[df[group_col] == ref_level, "correct"].values

    results = {}
    for level in sorted(df[group_col].unique()):
        vals = df.loc[df[group_col] == level, "correct"].values
        p = vals.mean()
        p_ref = ref.mean()
        odds = p / (1 - p) if 0 < p < 1 else float("inf")
        odds_ref = p_ref / (1 - p_ref) if 0 < p_ref < 1 else float("inf")
        or_val = (odds / odds_ref
                  if odds_ref not in (0, float("inf")) else None)

        boot_ors = []
        for _ in range(n_boot):
            br = rng.choice(ref, size=len(ref), replace=True)
            bs = rng.choice(vals, size=len(vals), replace=True)
            pr, ps = br.mean(), bs.mean()
            if 0 < pr < 1 and 0 < ps < 1:
                boot_ors.append((ps / (1 - ps)) / (pr / (1 - pr)))

        if boot_ors:
            ci_lo, ci_hi = np.percentile(boot_ors, [2.5, 97.5])
        else:
            ci_lo = ci_hi = None

        results[level] = dict(
            accuracy=round(float(p), 4),
            n=int(len(vals)),
            or_vs_ref=(round(float(or_val), 4)
                       if or_val is not None else None),
            or_ci_lower=(round(float(ci_lo), 4)
                         if ci_lo is not None else None),
            or_ci_upper=(round(float(ci_hi), 4)
                         if ci_hi is not None else None),
        )
    return results


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# LaTeX output
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _clean_param_name(name: str) -> str:
    """Shorten statsmodels-style parameter names for LaTeX."""
    name = name.replace("C(formulation)", "Form.")
    name = name.replace("C(model)", "Model")
    name = name.replace("C(complexity)", "Compl.")
    name = name.replace("C(mutation_type)", "Mut.")
    name = name.replace("[T.", "[")
    return name.replace("_", r"\_")


def _fmt_p(p: float | None) -> str:
    if p is None:
        return "---"
    if p < 0.001:
        return "$<$.001"
    s = f"{p:.3f}"
    if p < 0.01:
        return s + "**"
    if p < 0.05:
        return s + "*"
    return s


def format_latex_table(results: dict, caption: str, label: str) -> str:
    coeffs = results["coefficients"]
    re = results["random_effects"]

    lines = [
        r"\begin{table}[t]",
        r"\centering\small",
        rf"\caption{{{caption}}}",
        rf"\label{{{label}}}",
        r"\begin{tabular}{lrrrr}",
        r"\toprule",
        r"Effect & Coef.\ (pp) & SE & $z$ & $p$ \\",
        r"\midrule",
    ]
    for name, v in coeffs.items():
        dn = _clean_param_name(name)
        lines.append(
            f"{dn} & {v['coef']:+.3f} & {v['se']:.3f} "
            f"& {v['z']:.2f} & {_fmt_p(v['p'])} \\\\"
        )
    lines.append(r"\midrule")
    lines.append(
        rf"$\sigma^2_{{\text{{pid}}}}$ & "
        rf"\multicolumn{{4}}{{c}}{{{re['variance']:.4f} "
        rf"(SD={re['sd']:.3f})}} \\"
    )
    lines += [r"\bottomrule", r"\end{tabular}", r"\end{table}"]
    return "\n".join(lines)


def format_or_latex(or_dict: dict, ref: str, caption: str,
                    label: str) -> str:
    """LaTeX table for empirical odds ratios."""
    lines = [
        r"\begin{table}[t]",
        r"\centering\small",
        rf"\caption{{{caption}}}",
        rf"\label{{{label}}}",
        r"\begin{tabular}{lrrrl}",
        r"\toprule",
        rf"Formulation & Acc. & OR (vs.\ {ref}) & 95\% CI & $n$ \\",
        r"\midrule",
    ]
    for level, v in or_dict.items():
        or_str = (f"{v['or_vs_ref']:.2f}"
                  if v["or_vs_ref"] is not None else "ref")
        ci_str = (f"[{v['or_ci_lower']:.2f}, {v['or_ci_upper']:.2f}]"
                  if v["or_ci_lower"] is not None else "---")
        if level == ref:
            or_str, ci_str = "1.00", "ref"
        lines.append(
            f"{level} & {v['accuracy']:.3f} & {or_str} & {ci_str} "
            f"& {v['n']} \\\\"
        )
    lines += [r"\bottomrule", r"\end{tabular}", r"\end{table}"]
    return "\n".join(lines)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Main
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def main():
    args = parse_args()
    eval_dirs = [d.strip() for d in args.eval_dirs.split(",") if d.strip()]
    os.makedirs(args.output_dir, exist_ok=True)

    metadata = None
    if args.data_dir:
        metadata = load_metadata(args.data_dir)
        print(f"Metadata: {len(metadata)} problems loaded", file=sys.stderr)

    df = build_dataframe(eval_dirs, metadata)
    if df.empty:
        print("ERROR: no data loaded — check --eval_dirs", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)

    print(f"\nData: {len(df)} obs, {df['problem_id'].nunique()} problems",
          file=sys.stderr)
    print(f"  formulations : {sorted(df['formulation'].unique())}",
          file=sys.stderr)
    print(f"  models       : {sorted(df['model'].unique())}",
          file=sys.stderr)
    print(f"  seeds        : {sorted(df['seed'].unique())}",
          file=sys.stderr)
    print(f"  complexity   : {sorted(df['complexity'].unique())}",
          file=sys.stderr)
    mt = df["mutation_type"].unique()
    if not (len(mt) == 1 and mt[0] == "unknown"):
        print(f"  mutation_type: {sorted(mt)}", file=sys.stderr)

    print("\nCell accuracy (formulation × model × complexity):",
          file=sys.stderr)
    grp = df.groupby(["formulation", "model", "complexity"])["correct"]
    print(grp.agg(["mean", "count"]).round(4).to_string(), file=sys.stderr)

    all_results: dict = {}
    latex_parts: list[str] = []

    # ---- choose complexity variable ----
    has_mutation = (df["mutation_type"].nunique() > 1
                    and (df["mutation_type"] != "unknown").any())
    cx_col = "mutation_type" if has_mutation else "complexity"

    # ==== Model 1: cross-complexity ====
    if df[cx_col].nunique() >= 2:
        formula1 = f"correct ~ C(formulation) * C({cx_col})"
        res1, _ = fit_mixed_lm(
            df, formula1,
            label=f"Model 1 (cross-complexity): {formula1}")
        or1 = empirical_odds_ratios(
            df, "formulation", args.ref_formulation, args.bootstrap_n)
        res1["empirical_or_by_formulation"] = or1
        all_results["cross_complexity"] = res1

        latex_parts.append(format_latex_table(
            res1,
            caption=(r"Mixed-effects LPM: formulation $\times$ "
                     "complexity interaction."),
            label="tab:w5-complexity"))
        latex_parts.append(format_or_latex(
            or1, args.ref_formulation,
            caption="Empirical odds ratios by formulation (cross-complexity).",
            label="tab:w5-or-complexity"))
    else:
        print(f"\nSKIP Model 1: {cx_col} has only 1 level", file=sys.stderr)

    # ==== Model 2: cross-model ====
    if df["model"].nunique() >= 2:
        formula2 = "correct ~ C(formulation) * C(model)"
        res2, _ = fit_mixed_lm(
            df, formula2,
            label=f"Model 2 (cross-model): {formula2}")
        for m in sorted(df["model"].unique()):
            sub = df[df["model"] == m]
            or_m = empirical_odds_ratios(
                sub, "formulation", args.ref_formulation, args.bootstrap_n)
            res2[f"empirical_or_{m}"] = or_m
        all_results["cross_model"] = res2

        latex_parts.append(format_latex_table(
            res2,
            caption=(r"Mixed-effects LPM: formulation $\times$ "
                     "model interaction."),
            label="tab:w5-model"))
    else:
        print("\nSKIP Model 2: only 1 model in data", file=sys.stderr)

    # ---- save ----
    json_path = os.path.join(args.output_dir, "w5_mixed_effects_results.json")
    with open(json_path, "w") as f:
        json.dump(all_results, f, indent=2, default=str)

    latex_path = os.path.join(args.output_dir, "w5_latex_tables.tex")
    with open(latex_path, "w") as f:
        f.write("\n\n".join(latex_parts))

    print(f"\nSaved: {json_path}", file=sys.stderr)
    print(f"Saved: {latex_path}", file=sys.stderr)

    # stdout: JSON for piping
    print(json.dumps(all_results, indent=2, default=str))

"""
W5 Mixed-Effects Logistic Regression: formulation x model on repair verification accuracy.

Model 1: correct ~ formulation * model + (1|problem_id)        [repo-level only]
Model 2: correct ~ formulation * complexity + (1|problem_id)    [deepseek, repo+func]

Input:  per-sample prediction JSONL files from CLS / CWM evals
        (each line: {"problem_id": ..., "correct": 0|1, ...})
Output: fixed-effect coefficient table, random-effect variance, p-values

Dependencies: pandas, statsmodels (>=0.14)
"""

import json, sys, os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from pathlib import Path

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Configuration: eval prediction file paths (on the server)
# Each entry: (formulation, model, seed, filepath, complexity)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

EVAL_FILES = [
    # --- CLS (repo-level) ---
    ("CLS", "qwen3-8b", 42,
     "/root/autodl-tmp/eval_results/cls8b_s42_ckpt2200_test/predictions.jsonl",
     "repo"),
    ("CLS", "qwen3-8b", 456,
     "/root/autodl-tmp/eval_results/cls8b_repo_s456_ckpt2200/predictions.jsonl",
     "repo"),

    ("CLS", "deepseek-6.7b", 42,
     "/root/autodl-tmp/eval_results/deepseek_cls_repo_v5_ckpt2105_test_seq8192/predictions.jsonl",
     "repo"),
    ("CLS", "deepseek-6.7b", 123,
     "/root/autodl-tmp/eval_results/deepseek_cls_repo_s123_test/predictions.jsonl",
     "repo"),
    ("CLS", "deepseek-6.7b", 456,
     "/root/autodl-tmp/eval_results/deepseek_cls_repo_s456_ckpt2163/predictions.jsonl",
     "repo"),

    # --- CWM (repo-level) ---
    ("CWM", "qwen3-8b", 42,
     "/root/autodl-tmp/eval_results/qwen3_8b_cwm_repo_s42_ckpt400_seq4096/eval_repo_cwm_predictions.jsonl",
     "repo"),

    ("CWM", "deepseek-6.7b", 42,
     "/root/autodl-tmp/eval_results/deepseek_cwm_repo_s42_seq4096/eval_repo_cwm_predictions.jsonl",
     "repo"),
    ("CWM", "deepseek-6.7b", 123,
     "/root/autodl-tmp/eval_results/deepseek_cwm_repo_s123_test/eval_deepseek_cwm_repo_s123_predictions.jsonl",
     "repo"),

    # --- CLS (function-level) ---
    ("CLS", "deepseek-6.7b", 42,
     "/root/autodl-tmp/eval_results/deepseek_cls_func_test/predictions.jsonl",
     "function"),
    ("CLS", "deepseek-6.7b", 123,
     "/root/autodl-tmp/eval_results/deepseek_cls_func_s123_test/predictions_func.jsonl",
     "function"),

    # --- CWM (function-level) ---
    ("CWM", "deepseek-6.7b", 42,
     "/root/autodl-tmp/eval_results/deepseek_cwm_func_test/predictions.jsonl",
     "function"),
    ("CWM", "deepseek-6.7b", 123,
     "/root/autodl-tmp/eval_results/deepseek_cwm_func_s123_test/eval_repo_cwm_predictions.jsonl",
     "function"),
]


def load_predictions(path: str) -> list[dict]:
    records = []
    with open(path) as f:
        for line in f:
            line = line.strip()
            if not line:
                continue
            records.append(json.loads(line))
    return records


def build_dataframe(eval_files: list[tuple]) -> pd.DataFrame:
    rows = []
    for formulation, model, seed, fpath, complexity in eval_files:
        if not fpath or not os.path.exists(fpath):
            print(f"SKIP (file not found): {formulation} / {model} / s{seed} / {complexity}: {fpath}")
            continue
        preds = load_predictions(fpath)
        print(f"LOAD: {formulation} / {model} / s{seed} / {complexity}: {len(preds)} samples from {fpath}")
        for rec in preds:
            pid = rec.get("problem_id") or rec.get("instance_id") or rec.get("task_id") or rec.get("id")
            correct = rec.get("correct")
            if pid is None or correct is None:
                continue
            rows.append({
                "problem_id": pid,
                "formulation": formulation,
                "model": model,
                "seed": seed,
                "correct": int(correct),
                "complexity": complexity,
            })
    df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    return df


def fit_glmm(df: pd.DataFrame):
    """Fit binomial GLMM: correct ~ formulation * model + (1|problem_id)."""
    from statsmodels.genmod.bayes_mixed_glm import BinomialBayesMixedGLM

    df = df.copy()
    df["formulation"] = pd.Categorical(df["formulation"])
    df["model"] = pd.Categorical(df["model"])

    formula_vars = pd.get_dummies(df[["formulation", "model"]], drop_first=True, dtype=float)
    form_cols = [c for c in formula_vars.columns if c.startswith("formulation_")]
    model_cols = [c for c in formula_vars.columns if c.startswith("model_")]
    for fc in form_cols:
        for mc in model_cols:
            formula_vars[f"{fc}:{mc}"] = formula_vars[fc] * formula_vars[mc]

    exog = formula_vars.copy()
    exog.insert(0, "Intercept", 1.0)
    endog = df["correct"].values

    ident = pd.get_dummies(df["problem_id"], dtype=float)

    print(f"\nFitting BinomialBayesMixedGLM...")
    print(f"  Fixed effects: {list(exog.columns)}")
    print(f"  Random groups (problem_id): {ident.shape[1]} unique problems")
    print(f"  Observations: {len(endog)}")

    mod = BinomialBayesMixedGLM(
        endog, exog, exog_vc=ident, ident=np.zeros(ident.shape[1], dtype=int)
    )
    import warnings
    with warnings.catch_warnings():
        warnings.simplefilter("ignore")
        result = mod.fit_vb()
    return result, exog.columns.tolist()


def fit_lpm(df: pd.DataFrame):
    """Fallback: Linear probability model with MixedLM."""
    import statsmodels.formula.api as smf

    df = df.copy()
    df["formulation"] = df["formulation"].astype(str)
    df["model"] = df["model"].astype(str)

    formula = "correct ~ C(formulation) * C(model)"
    print(f"\nFitting MixedLM (linear probability model)...")
    print(f"  Formula: {formula} + (1|problem_id)")
    print(f"  Observations: {len(df)}")

    md = smf.mixedlm(formula, df, groups=df["problem_id"])
    result = md.fit(reml=True)
    return result


def fit_complexity_interaction(df: pd.DataFrame):
    """Fit: correct ~ formulation * complexity + (1|problem_id)."""
    import statsmodels.formula.api as smf

    df = df.copy()
    df["formulation"] = df["formulation"].astype(str)
    df["complexity"] = df["complexity"].astype(str)

    formula = "correct ~ C(formulation) * C(complexity)"
    print(f"\nFitting MixedLM (complexity interaction)...")
    print(f"  Formula: {formula} + (1|problem_id)")
    print(f"  Observations: {len(df)}")
    print(f"  Unique problem_ids: {df['problem_id'].nunique()}")
    print(f"  Cell counts:")
    print(df.groupby(["formulation", "complexity"]).size().to_string())

    md = smf.mixedlm(formula, df, groups=df["problem_id"])
    result = md.fit(reml=True)
    return result


def main():
    print("=" * 70)
    print("W5 Mixed-Effects Logistic Regression")
    print("=" * 70)

    df = build_dataframe(EVAL_FILES)
    if df.empty:
        print("ERROR: No data loaded. Check file paths.")
        sys.exit(1)

    print(f"\n--- Data Summary (all) ---")
    print(f"Total observations: {len(df)}")
    print(f"Unique problem_ids: {df['problem_id'].nunique()}")
    print(f"\nBy complexity:")
    for c in df["complexity"].unique():
        sub = df[df["complexity"] == c]
        print(f"  {c}: {len(sub)} obs, {sub['problem_id'].nunique()} problems")
    print(f"\nCell accuracy (formulation x model x complexity):")
    print(df.groupby(["formulation", "model", "complexity"])["correct"].mean().round(4).to_string())

    out_lines = []

    # ---- Model 1: formulation * model on repo-level only ----
    df_repo = df[df["complexity"] == "repo"].copy()
    print("\n" + "=" * 70)
    print("MODEL 1: correct ~ formulation * model + (1|problem_id)  [repo-level]")
    print("=" * 70)
    print(f"\nRepo-level observations: {len(df_repo)}")
    print(f"Unique problem_ids (repo): {df_repo['problem_id'].nunique()}")
    print(f"\nCell counts (formulation x model x seed):")
    print(df_repo.groupby(["formulation", "model", "seed"]).size().to_string())
    print(f"\nCell accuracy (formulation x model):")
    print(df_repo.groupby(["formulation", "model"])["correct"].mean().round(4).to_string())

    try:
        result_glmm, col_names = fit_glmm(df_repo)
        print("\n--- Bayesian GLMM Results (BinomialBayesMixedGLM) ---")
        print(result_glmm.summary())
        out_lines.append("=== MODEL 1: Bayesian GLMM (repo-level) ===\n")
        out_lines.append(str(result_glmm.summary()))

        print("\n--- Fixed Effects (logit scale) ---")
        fe = result_glmm.fe_mean
        fe_sd = result_glmm.fe_sd
        for i, name in enumerate(col_names):
            z = fe[i] / fe_sd[i] if fe_sd[i] > 0 else float("inf")
            print(f"  {name:40s}  coef={fe[i]:+.4f}  sd={fe_sd[i]:.4f}  z={z:.2f}")

        print(f"\n--- Random Effects (problem_id) ---")
        print(f"  Variance component SD: {np.exp(result_glmm.vcp_mean[0]):.4f}")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"GLMM failed: {e}")

    result_lpm = fit_lpm(df_repo)
    print("\n--- Mixed LM Results (Linear Probability Model) ---")
    print(result_lpm.summary())
    out_lines.append("\n\n=== MODEL 1: Linear Probability Model (repo-level) ===\n")
    out_lines.append(str(result_lpm.summary()))

    # ---- Model 2: formulation * complexity on deepseek only (has both levels) ----
    df_ds = df[df["model"] == "deepseek-6.7b"].copy()
    if df_ds["complexity"].nunique() >= 2:
        print("\n" + "=" * 70)
        print("MODEL 2: correct ~ formulation * complexity + (1|problem_id)  [deepseek only]")
        print("=" * 70)

        result_cx = fit_complexity_interaction(df_ds)
        print("\n--- Complexity Interaction Results ---")
        print(result_cx.summary())
        out_lines.append("\n\n=== MODEL 2: Complexity Interaction (deepseek, repo+func) ===\n")
        out_lines.append(str(result_cx.summary()))
    else:
        print("\nSKIP Model 2: need both repo and function complexity levels")

    # --- Save results ---
    out_path = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__) or ".", "artifacts", "w5_glmm_results.txt")
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(out_path), exist_ok=True)
    with open(out_path, "w") as f:
        f.write("\n".join(out_lines))
    print(f"\nResults saved to {out_path}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

557	\label{app:limitations}
558	
559	The same-size 4B comparison uses a single seed; \cls{} 4B seed 123 (val-best ckpt-800) achieves only 75.33\% test accuracy (+2.4\pp{} above majority baseline); val-best selection at an early checkpoint (step 800) amplifies the val-test distribution shift observed across all configurations. Our training data is synthetically constructed from mutation operators rather than real developer patches. While mutation testing literature establishes that mutants are reasonable proxies for real faults in test effectiveness studies~\cite{andrews2005mutation,just2014mutants}, these findings concern mutation \emph{adequacy} (whether tests that kill mutants also detect real faults), not whether verifiers trained on mutants transfer to real patches. However, the coupling effect underlying these results supports \emph{relative ranking} validity: a domain shift from synthetic mutations to real bugs may affect absolute accuracy levels, but our core finding---that formulation choice matters at repo level but not function level---concerns relative performance ordering, which is expected to be preserved under distributional shifts that affect all formulations equally. The synthetic-to-real transfer gap for absolute accuracy remains untested. The \traj{} training configuration differs from \cls{}/\cwm{}: smaller training set (${\sim}$400 vs.\ ${\sim}$70K instances), different learning rate ($2{\times}10^{-4}$ vs.\ $5{\times}10^{-5}$), and variant-level evaluation ($n{=}48$ vs.\ per-test $n{=}9{,}784$). The NF4 seeds contribute precision (narrowing the CI) without shifting the mean, consistent with precision being comparable across both quantization levels at function level. Repo-level \cls{}--\traj{} comparison should be interpreted with caution due to configuration and granularity differences.

"""
Logistic regression supplement for Appendix M (Mixed-Effects Regression).

Fits GEE logistic regression + cluster-robust logistic regression to the
same data used for the LPM analysis. Reports odds ratios, 95% CIs, and
average marginal effects (AME) for direct comparison with LPM coefficients.

Models:
  1. Cross-complexity (DeepSeek only): correct ~ formulation × complexity + (1|problem_id)
  2. Repo-level cross-model: correct ~ formulation × model + (1|problem_id)

Output: JSON results + markdown report
"""

import json
import os
import sys

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


EVAL_FILES = [
    # --- DeepSeek CLS repo ---
    ("CLS", "DeepSeek-6.7B", 42,
     "/root/autodl-tmp/eval_results/deepseek_cls_repo_v5_ckpt2105_test_seq8192/predictions.jsonl",
     "repo"),
    ("CLS", "DeepSeek-6.7B", 123,
     "/root/autodl-tmp/eval_results/deepseek_cls_repo_s123_test/predictions.jsonl",
     "repo"),
    ("CLS", "DeepSeek-6.7B", 456,
     "/root/autodl-tmp/eval_results/deepseek_cls_repo_s456_ckpt2163/predictions.jsonl",
     "repo"),
    # --- DeepSeek CWM repo ---
    ("CWM", "DeepSeek-6.7B", 42,
     "/root/autodl-tmp/eval_results/deepseek_cwm_repo_s42_seq4096/eval_repo_cwm_predictions.jsonl",
     "repo"),
    ("CWM", "DeepSeek-6.7B", 123,
     "/root/autodl-tmp/eval_results/deepseek_cwm_repo_s123_test/eval_deepseek_cwm_repo_s123_predictions.jsonl",
     "repo"),
    # --- DeepSeek CLS function ---
    ("CLS", "DeepSeek-6.7B", 42,
     "/root/autodl-tmp/eval_results/deepseek_cls_func_test/predictions.jsonl",
     "function"),
    ("CLS", "DeepSeek-6.7B", 123,
     "/root/autodl-tmp/eval_results/deepseek_cls_func_s123_test/predictions_func.jsonl",
     "function"),
    # --- DeepSeek CWM function ---
    ("CWM", "DeepSeek-6.7B", 42,
     "/root/autodl-tmp/eval_results/deepseek_cwm_func_test/predictions.jsonl",
     "function"),
    ("CWM", "DeepSeek-6.7B", 123,
     "/root/autodl-tmp/eval_results/deepseek_cwm_func_s123_test/eval_repo_cwm_predictions.jsonl",
     "function"),
    # --- Qwen CLS repo ---
    ("CLS", "Qwen3-8B", 42,
     "/root/autodl-tmp/eval_results/cls8b_s42_ckpt2200_test/predictions.jsonl",
     "repo"),
    ("CLS", "Qwen3-8B", 456,
     "/root/autodl-tmp/eval_results/cls8b_repo_s456_ckpt2200/predictions.jsonl",
     "repo"),
    # --- Qwen CWM repo ---
    ("CWM", "Qwen3-8B", 42,
     "/root/autodl-tmp/eval_results/qwen3_8b_cwm_repo_s42_ckpt400_seq4096/eval_repo_cwm_predictions.jsonl",
     "repo"),
]


def load_jsonl(path):
    records = []
    with open(path) as f:
        for line in f:
            line = line.strip()
            if line:
                records.append(json.loads(line))
    return records


def build_dataframe(eval_files):
    rows = []
    for formulation, model, seed, fpath, complexity in eval_files:
        if not os.path.exists(fpath):
            print(f"SKIP: {fpath}", file=sys.stderr)
            continue
        preds = load_jsonl(fpath)
        tag = f"{formulation}/{model}/s{seed}/{complexity}"
        print(f"LOAD {tag}: {len(preds)} samples", file=sys.stderr)
        for rec in preds:
            pid = (rec.get("problem_id") or rec.get("instance_id")
                   or rec.get("task_id") or rec.get("id"))
            correct = rec.get("correct")
            if correct is None:
                label = rec.get("label")
                pred = rec.get("pred")
                if label is not None and pred is not None:
                    correct = int(label == pred)
            if pid is None or correct is None:
                continue
            rows.append({
                "problem_id": pid,
                "formulation": formulation,
                "model": model,
                "seed": seed,
                "correct": int(correct),
                "complexity": complexity,
            })
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)


def fit_gee_logistic(df, formula_str, groups_col="problem_id", label=""):
    """GEE with binomial family and exchangeable correlation."""
    import statsmodels.api as sm
    import statsmodels.formula.api as smf
    from statsmodels.genmod.generalized_estimating_equations import GEE
    from statsmodels.genmod.families import Binomial
    from statsmodels.genmod.cov_struct import Exchangeable

    df = df.copy().sort_values(groups_col).reset_index(drop=True)
    for col in ["formulation", "model", "complexity"]:
        if col in df.columns:
            df[col] = df[col].astype(str)

    print(f"\n{'='*60}", file=sys.stderr)
    print(f"GEE Logistic: {label}", file=sys.stderr)
    print(f"  {formula_str}, groups={groups_col}", file=sys.stderr)
    print(f"  N={len(df)}, clusters={df[groups_col].nunique()}", file=sys.stderr)

    model = GEE.from_formula(
        formula_str, groups=groups_col, data=df,
        family=Binomial(), cov_struct=Exchangeable()
    )
    result = model.fit(maxiter=100)
    print(result.summary(), file=sys.stderr)
    return result, df


def compute_odds_ratios(result):
    """Extract odds ratios and 95% CIs from logistic model."""
    params = result.params
    ci = result.conf_int()
    pvals = result.pvalues

    ors = {}
    for name in params.index:
        coef = float(params[name])
        ci_lo, ci_hi = float(ci.loc[name, 0]), float(ci.loc[name, 1])
        ors[name] = {
            "log_odds": round(coef, 4),
            "OR": round(np.exp(coef), 4),
            "OR_ci_lower": round(np.exp(ci_lo), 4),
            "OR_ci_upper": round(np.exp(ci_hi), 4),
            "z": round(float(result.tvalues[name]), 3),
            "p": round(float(pvals[name]), 6),
        }
    return ors


def compute_ame(result, df, formula_str):
    """Average Marginal Effects for the formulation variable."""
    from patsy import dmatrix

    df = df.copy()
    for col in ["formulation", "model", "complexity"]:
        if col in df.columns:
            df[col] = df[col].astype(str)

    ame_results = {}

    # AME for formulation (CWM vs CLS)
    if "formulation" in formula_str:
        df0 = df.copy()
        df1 = df.copy()
        df0["formulation"] = "CLS"
        df1["formulation"] = "CWM"

        X0 = dmatrix(result.model.formula.split("~")[1].strip(), df0, return_type="dataframe")
        X1 = dmatrix(result.model.formula.split("~")[1].strip(), df1, return_type="dataframe")

        beta = result.params.values
        p0 = 1 / (1 + np.exp(-X0.values @ beta))
        p1 = 1 / (1 + np.exp(-X1.values @ beta))
        ame_cwm = float(np.mean(p1 - p0))
        ame_results["CWM_vs_CLS"] = round(ame_cwm, 4)

    # AME by complexity subgroup
    if "complexity" in formula_str and "formulation" in formula_str:
        for cx in ["function", "repo"]:
            sub = df[df["complexity"] == cx].copy()
            if len(sub) == 0:
                continue
            df0 = sub.copy()
            df1 = sub.copy()
            df0["formulation"] = "CLS"
            df1["formulation"] = "CWM"

            rhs = result.model.formula.split("~")[1].strip()
            X0 = dmatrix(rhs, df0, return_type="dataframe")
            X1 = dmatrix(rhs, df1, return_type="dataframe")

            beta = result.params.values
            p0 = 1 / (1 + np.exp(-X0.values @ beta))
            p1 = 1 / (1 + np.exp(-X1.values @ beta))
            ame_cx = float(np.mean(p1 - p0))
            ame_results[f"CWM_vs_CLS_{cx}"] = round(ame_cx, 4)

    return ame_results


def fit_cluster_robust_logistic(df, formula_str, groups_col="problem_id", label=""):
    """Standard logistic regression with cluster-robust (sandwich) SEs."""
    import statsmodels.formula.api as smf

    df = df.copy()
    for col in ["formulation", "model", "complexity"]:
        if col in df.columns:
            df[col] = df[col].astype(str)

    print(f"\n{'='*60}", file=sys.stderr)
    print(f"Cluster-Robust Logistic: {label}", file=sys.stderr)
    print(f"  {formula_str}, cluster={groups_col}", file=sys.stderr)

    model = smf.logit(formula_str, data=df)
    result = model.fit(cov_type="cluster", cov_kwds={"groups": df[groups_col]},
                       disp=False, maxiter=100)
    print(result.summary(), file=sys.stderr)
    return result, df


def main():
    print("="*70, file=sys.stderr)
    print("Logistic Regression Analysis for Appendix M", file=sys.stderr)
    print("="*70, file=sys.stderr)

    df_all = build_dataframe(EVAL_FILES)
    if df_all.empty:
        print("ERROR: no data loaded", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)

    print(f"\nTotal: {len(df_all)} obs, {df_all['problem_id'].nunique()} problems",
          file=sys.stderr)
    print(f"Cell accuracy:", file=sys.stderr)
    print(df_all.groupby(["formulation", "model", "complexity"])["correct"]
          .agg(["mean", "count"]).round(4).to_string(), file=sys.stderr)

    results = {}

    # ================================================================
    # Model 1: Cross-complexity (DeepSeek only)
    # ================================================================
    df_ds = df_all[df_all["model"] == "DeepSeek-6.7B"].copy()
    print(f"\n--- DeepSeek cross-complexity: {len(df_ds)} obs ---", file=sys.stderr)

    formula1 = "correct ~ C(formulation, Treatment('CLS')) * C(complexity, Treatment('function'))"

    # GEE logistic
    gee1, gee1_df = fit_gee_logistic(df_ds, formula1, label="Cross-complexity (DeepSeek)")
    or1 = compute_odds_ratios(gee1)
    ame1 = compute_ame(gee1, gee1_df, formula1)

    # Cluster-robust logistic (for comparison)
    cr1, cr1_df = fit_cluster_robust_logistic(df_ds, formula1, label="Cross-complexity (DeepSeek)")
    or1_cr = compute_odds_ratios(cr1)
    ame1_cr = compute_ame(cr1, cr1_df, formula1)

    results["cross_complexity_gee"] = {
        "method": "GEE (exchangeable)",
        "n_obs": len(df_ds),
        "n_clusters": int(df_ds["problem_id"].nunique()),
        "odds_ratios": or1,
        "ame": ame1,
    }
    results["cross_complexity_cluster_robust"] = {
        "method": "Cluster-robust logistic",
        "n_obs": len(df_ds),
        "n_clusters": int(df_ds["problem_id"].nunique()),
        "odds_ratios": or1_cr,
        "ame": ame1_cr,
    }

    # ================================================================
    # Model 2: Cross-model (repo-level only)
    # ================================================================
    df_repo = df_all[df_all["complexity"] == "repo"].copy()
    print(f"\n--- Repo cross-model: {len(df_repo)} obs ---", file=sys.stderr)

    formula2 = "correct ~ C(formulation, Treatment('CLS')) * C(model, Treatment('DeepSeek-6.7B'))"

    gee2, gee2_df = fit_gee_logistic(df_repo, formula2, label="Cross-model (repo)")
    or2 = compute_odds_ratios(gee2)
    ame2 = compute_ame(gee2, gee2_df, formula2)

    cr2, cr2_df = fit_cluster_robust_logistic(df_repo, formula2, label="Cross-model (repo)")
    or2_cr = compute_odds_ratios(cr2)
    ame2_cr = compute_ame(cr2, cr2_df, formula2)

    results["cross_model_gee"] = {
        "method": "GEE (exchangeable)",
        "n_obs": len(df_repo),
        "n_clusters": int(df_repo["problem_id"].nunique()),
        "odds_ratios": or2,
        "ame": ame2,
    }
    results["cross_model_cluster_robust"] = {
        "method": "Cluster-robust logistic",
        "n_obs": len(df_repo),
        "n_clusters": int(df_repo["problem_id"].nunique()),
        "odds_ratios": or2_cr,
        "ame": ame2_cr,
    }

    # Save JSON
    out_dir = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__) or ".", "artifacts")
    os.makedirs(out_dir, exist_ok=True)
    json_path = os.path.join(out_dir, "logistic_regression_results.json")
    with open(json_path, "w") as f:
        json.dump(results, f, indent=2, default=str)
    print(f"\nSaved: {json_path}", file=sys.stderr)

    # Print JSON to stdout
    print(json.dumps(results, indent=2, default=str))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
